defs.def: if sb/sth has a particular tendency, they are likely to behave or act in a particular way 倾向；偏好；性情

ex.s: So, your brain’s tendency to ask, “Is it worth it? ” will be hard to quieten.
ex.t: 所以，你大脑倾向于问'值得吗？'的倾向将很难被平息。

ex.s: My perfectionist tendencies were the main root of this: I wanted to be perfect at whatever I did, which obviously in life is not possible, but it consumed me.
ex.t: 我的完美主义倾向是主要原因：我想在所做的任何事情上都做到完美，这在生活中显然是不可能的，但它吞噬了我。

ex.s: For instance, we may have a tendency to catch a cold easily.
ex.t: 例如，我们可能有容易感冒的倾向。

ex.s: People have a tendency to lean towards whatever they are interested in.
ex.t: 人们倾向于倾向于任何他们感兴趣的东西。

ex.s: With these severe restrictions to her communication, Helen'sbehaviourwas oftenunbearable.Shewassometimestroublesome,stubborn and angry, and had a tendency to break things when no one understood her.
ex.t: 海伦的举止经常是无法忍受的，有时她令人讨厌，生生生和愤怒，在没有人理解她时，她有打破事物的倾向。

defs.def: a new custom that is starting to develop 趋势；趋向

ex.s: As we can see, emojis have a tendency to pop up all over the place.
ex.t: 正如我们所看到的那样，爱莫吉人有一种到处出现的趋势。

ex.s: Being single, Ma Ming often held parties at night, but the biggest problem was his tendency to drum late at night.
ex.t: 由于单身，马明经常在晚上举行聚会，但最大的问题在于他往往在深夜打鼓。

ex.s: They also believe they have now identified the genes that may cause this tendency.
ex.t: 他们还认为，他们现在已经确定了可能造成这种趋势的基因。

defs.def: a group within a larger political group, whose views are more extreme than those of the rest of the group （政党内的）极端派别
